result.instructions: A card is one task on this repository's Kanban board: the file `.repoboard/cards/<id>.md`, YAML frontmatter (id, title, status, assignee, priority, size, labels, files, refs, parent, phase, gate, decision, created, updated) plus a markdown body with a `## Log` section. `status` is always a column id from `.repoboard/board.yml`. A card may carry a `decision` block (P8.1): a question, optional lettered options, and — once answered — `chosen`/`words`. A DECIDED card is authority: do not re-ask it and do not wait for a relay — read `decision.chosen` and `decision.words` yourself. RCB-68: `parent` makes a card a STEP of that phase card; `phase` (e.g. `PH.3`) marks which step; `gate` (a card id or a sentence) is what blocks it — a card-id gate clears once that card is done or decided. Column ids on this board: backlog, decide, todo, doing, done. Call list_cards or board_summary first to see what exists. Before starting a task, move its card to the active column (usually `doing`) with your actor name; when done, append_log what you verified (or move it to `done` if you own that call). Use ask_owner when a task needs a human decision instead of guessing or waiting on a chat relay.

tools.name: list_cards
tools.title: List cards
tools.description: Returns a compact JSON array of {id, title, status, assignee, priority, size, labels, files, parent, phase, gate, blocked, updated} without bodies (RCB-68: parent, phase, gate mirror the frontmatter; blocked is the reason or null). Call this first: it is the cheap way to learn what exists and which column ids are in use (this board: backlog, decide, todo, doing, done). Filters are exact matches and combine with AND; omit them all for every card. Pass full: true only when you need every body at once (several times the bytes); get_card is cheaper for one.

status.description: Only cards in this column id (one of: backlog, decide, todo, doing, done).

assignee.description: Only cards whose assignee equals this string.

label.description: Only cards whose labels include this label.

needsDecision.description: Only cards with an OPEN decision (asked, not yet answered) — the owner queue.

parent.description: RCB-68: only that card's STEPS, in phase order (not id order).

unblocked.description: With parent: keep only its not-done, not-blocked steps.

full.description: Include each card's markdown body and `## Log`. Default false.

tools.name: get_card
tools.title: Get one card
tools.description: A DECIDED card is authority: read `decision.chosen`/`words`, do not re-ask. Returns the full card as JSON, including its markdown body and `## Log` history. Use list_cards to find ids. With resolveRefs: true, `refs` becomes the referenced lines read live from each file: [{spec, path, start, end, text, truncated, error}], text null with an error when a ref does not resolve.

id.description: The card id from its frontmatter, e.g. RB-12.

resolveRefs.description: Replace the refs: specs with their resolved lines. Default false.

tools.name: create_card
tools.title: Create a card
tools.description: Creates a new card file with the next free id and returns it. `status` must be a column id (this board: backlog, decide, todo, doing, done); it defaults to the first column. Titles may contain anything; they are quoted on disk for you.

status.description: Column id (one of: backlog, decide, todo, doing, done). Default: first column.

size.description: S ≤2h · M half a day · L days, investigate first · XL plan-sized

refs.description: Pointers the board renders live: path#Heading, path@Token, path:L10-L20, or path. Point at where a note lives instead of pasting it into the body.

body.description: Markdown description. A `## Log` section is added on first log line.

parent.description: RCB-68: makes this card a STEP of that card.

phase.description: RCB-68: free short label, e.g. PH.3.

gate.description: RCB-68: a card id or a sentence naming what blocks this card.

actor.description: Who is acting, written `<tool>/<role>` (e.g. `claude/web-agent`) so the board can draw a stable avatar. Defaults to $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: move_card
tools.title: Move a card to a column
tools.description: `status` is a column id from board.yml (see list_cards). Sets the card's status to another column id (this board: backlog, decide, todo, doing, done), bumps `updated`, appends a `## Log` line and records an event. Returns {card, warnings}. Exceeding a column's WIP limit is reported as a warning in the result, never refused; moving to the column the card is already in is also just a warning.

status.description: Destination column id (one of: backlog, decide, todo, doing, done).

actor.description: Who is acting, written `<tool>/<role>` (e.g. `claude/web-agent`) so the board can draw a stable avatar. Defaults to $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: update_card
tools.title: Update card fields
tools.description: Changes title, assignee, priority, size, labels, files, refs, parent, phase and/or gate, bumps `updated` and appends a `## Log` line naming the changed fields. Pass null to clear an optional field. Not for status (use move_card) or the body (use append_log).

labels.description: Replaces the list; null clears it.

files.description: Replaces the list; null clears it.

refs.description: Replaces the refs: list (path#Heading, path@Token, path:L10-L20, path); null clears it.

parent.description: RCB-68: makes this card a STEP of that card; null clears it.

phase.description: RCB-68: free short label, e.g. PH.3; null clears it.

gate.description: RCB-68: a card id or a sentence naming what blocks this card; null clears it.

actor.description: Who is acting, written `<tool>/<role>` (e.g. `claude/web-agent`) so the board can draw a stable avatar. Defaults to $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: append_log
tools.title: Append a log line to a card
tools.description: Appends one bullet `- <timestamp> <actor> — <text>` under the card's `## Log` heading (created if missing) and bumps `updated`. Use it to say what you did or verified. Text is kept to one line.

actor.description: Who is acting, written `<tool>/<role>` (e.g. `claude/web-agent`) so the board can draw a stable avatar. Defaults to $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: add_note
tools.title: Add a durable note to a card
tools.description: Appends one bullet `- <timestamp> <actor> — <text>` under the card's `## Notes` heading (created before `## Log` if missing) and bumps `updated`. Newlines in `text` are kept, as continuation lines under the same bullet. Writes no `## Log` line. Use it for a durable remark meant to stay on the card — a decision rationale, an owner's instruction — where append_log is for what you DID.

text.description: The remark, one or more lines.

actor.description: Who is acting, written `<tool>/<role>` (e.g. `claude/web-agent`) so the board can draw a stable avatar. Defaults to $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: ask_owner
tools.title: Ask the owner a decision, on the card
tools.description: Opens a `decision` block on a card: a question and optional lettered options. The owner answers from the dashboard (or `record_decision`) — do not wait on a chat relay; poll `get_card`/`list_cards` and read `decision.chosen`/`decision.words` when it is DECIDED (`chosen !== null || decidedAt !== null`). If the board has a column with `decision: true`, the card MOVES there (recording where it came from) and moves back when `record_decision` answers it; a board with no such column just shows a badge. Asking again on a card with an OPEN decision is refused — pass `replace: true` to withdraw it and ask a new one; asking again on a DECIDED card simply replaces it.

options.description: Lettered choices, e.g. [{letter:"A",text:"ship now"}]. Omit for a yes/no or free-text question — the owner then answers with words only.

replace.description: Withdraw an already-open decision and re-ask.

kind.description: An owner WORK item, same queue; no options; closed by record_decision with neither letter nor words.

actor.description: Who is acting, written `<tool>/<role>` (e.g. `claude/web-agent`) so the board can draw a stable avatar. Defaults to $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: record_decision
tools.title: Record the owner's answer to an open decision
tools.description: Answers the card's open `decision`: a `letter` naming one of its options, `words` (verbatim), or both — at least one is required. Refuses an unknown letter (names the valid ones) and refuses when nothing is open. Moves the card back to where `ask_owner` moved it from, if anywhere. On an owner task (RCB-52), neither a letter nor words is required — a bare call closes it.

letter.description: One of the decision’s option letters.

words.description: The verbatim answer, kept as written.

actor.description: Who is acting, written `<tool>/<role>` (e.g. `claude/web-agent`) so the board can draw a stable avatar. Defaults to $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: list_decisions
tools.title: Answered decisions, acknowledged or not
tools.description: RCB-129: catches the case where the owner answers a decision on another surface (the web) and nothing here changes otherwise — the card just leaves the OWNER QUEUE. Every card whose decision is answered (`chosen !== null || decidedAt !== null`), newest decidedAt first: {id, title, assignee, question, chosen, chosenText, words, decidedAt, decidedBy, acknowledged}. `acknowledged` is true once someone OTHER than decidedBy has written a `## Log` or `## Notes` line on the card after decidedAt — append_log and add_note both count. Default returns unacknowledged rows only.

since.description: ISO-8601, or HH:MMZ for that UTC time today. Filters on decidedAt.

all.description: Also return already-acknowledged rows. Default false.

tools.name: board_summary
tools.title: Board summary
tools.description: Returns the columns (id, title, active, wip, done, count), the active cards (in an `active` column and updated within activeWindowMinutes), WIP breaches, and any card files that failed to parse. No arguments.

tools.name: set_columns
tools.title: Replace the whole column list
tools.description: Replaces the board's ENTIRE column list in board.yml — a replace, not a merge, the same contract as HTTP PATCH /api/board and the web ColumnEditor (RCB-34): every column not included is dropped. Each column is {id, title?, active?, wip?, done?, decision?}; this tool does NOT validate that shape itself — the store re-parses board.yml through the same schema a hand edit would get, and refuses (naming the problem: empty list, duplicate id, etc.) with nothing written. Cards already on disk are never touched; one left in a column you removed still shows, marked "not in board.yml". Current columns: backlog, decide, todo, doing, done.

columns.description: The WHOLE new column list, in order.

actor.description: Who is acting, e.g. claude/agent. Default: $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: take_lease
tools.title: Take a lease on a resource
tools.description: Take/renew a lease on `resource`. Refuses a live lease held by another (names holder, until) unless force; same holder renews, replacing until/note (omit to clear).

actor.description: Who is acting, e.g. claude/agent. Default: $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: release_lease
tools.title: Release a lease
tools.description: Release a lease on a resource. Refuses on another holder's lease, naming them, unless force.

actor.description: Who is acting, e.g. claude/agent. Default: $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: list_leases
tools.title: List leases and windows
tools.description: Every held lease and time window in .repoboard/leases.yml: leases as [{resource, holder, since, until, state: live|stale, note}], windows as [{resource, start, end, name}]. Cheap; call before take_lease.

tools.name: add_window
tools.title: Add a time window on a resource
tools.description: Reserve `resource` for a named window (`end` after `start`, both ISO-8601), e.g. a scheduled sweep. No overlap check.

actor.description: Who is acting, e.g. claude/agent. Default: $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: check_window
tools.title: Is a resource clear right now?
tools.description: Call check_window before starting any long-running shared-resource job such as a test suite; exit/clear false means DO NOT start. Returns {clear:true} or {clear:false, reasons} naming a window covering `at` (default now), a live lease on resource, or both.

tools.name: get_state
tools.title: Get STATE.md, rendered
tools.description: The repo's one-page STATE.md: {stamp, actor, sections: {live, lastLandings, seats}, ownerQueue: [{id, question, options}], leases: [{resource, holder, since, until, state, note}], text}. OWNER QUEUE and LEASES (RCB-131: live leases only, in `text` too, right after OWNER QUEUE — never stored on disk) are both generated fresh from current data — never trust stale text from a prior read.

tools.name: set_state_section
tools.title: Replace one STATE.md section
tools.description: Replace LIVE, LAST-LANDINGS or SEATS and restamp; the other sections and OWNER QUEUE (generated, never stored) are untouched. Scaffolds a fresh STATE.md if none exists.

actor.description: Who is acting, e.g. claude/agent. Default: $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: append_repo_log
tools.title: Append one block to today's log
tools.description: Append `text` under a `##### <SEAT> <ts>: <title>` heading to today's log — board.yml logDir when set, else .repoboard/local/log/, else .repoboard/log/ (creates the file if this is the first entry). Append-only — there is no rewrite.

title.description: Defaults to the first line of text.

tools.name: get_log
tools.title: Read a day's log, or one seat's newest block
tools.description: Reads a day's log (default today): {date, blocks: [{seat, ts, title, text}]} — same object `log show --json` prints. `seat` narrows to one seat; `since` (full ISO-8601, or HH:MMZ for that UTC time on `date`) and `tail` (last N) narrow further, applied in that order. `last` (a seat name, exclusive with date/seat/since/tail) instead returns that seat's NEWEST block anywhere in the log: {date, block}, or nulls when it has none.

since.description: Full ISO-8601 datetime, or HH:MMZ for `date`.

last.description: A seat name; exclusive with date/seat/since/tail.

tools.name: get_seat
tools.title: Get one seat's cold-start bundle
tools.description: The cold-start bundle `seat <name> --json` prints: its SEATS line, its live leases (RCB-131: `isStale` false, `(yours)` marks its own), its last log block, the coordinator's, its next todo card and the open decisions. Read only — --up/--down/--update stay CLI-only.

tools.name: record_gate
tools.title: Record a gate check result
tools.description: Appends one line to the gate ledger — the SEAT'S OWN RECORD of a check it already ran, never a re-run. Needs at least one of tests (passed/skipped/failed/files), typecheck, lint, build; passed/skipped needs failed too (0 means a clean run). sha defaults to `git rev-parse --short HEAD` (null outside a git repo).

tools.name: get_gate
tools.title: Get the gate ledger
tools.description: The newest recorded result per check (tests, typecheck, lint, build) — the same object `gate show --json` prints. A check with nothing recorded yet is null.

tools.name: check
tools.title: Health check: STATE, leases, decisions
tools.description: Call before starting and before stopping (locked practice). Returns {findings, exitCode}: stale-state, active-without-lease (warning, strict-only), stale-lease, live-lease (info), needs-ask (warning, strict-only — no open ask), cost-over-budget, systems-invalid (error), systems-stale (warning), needs-decision (info). Empty findings means ok.

tools.name: cost
tools.title: Cold-context cost
tools.description: Bytes/≈tokens of what a cold agent loads: CLAUDE.md + variants, AGENTS.md + variants, backticked paths CLAUDE.md names that exist, and MCP server names (not schema bytes). over:true when CLAUDE.md exceeds budget (default 8192, or board.yml claudeMdBudgetBytes).

tools.name: list_systems
tools.title: List systems
tools.description: RCB-97 (plan §3.3): `.repoboard/systems.yml`'s inventory. Returns {exists, errors, environments, systems: [{id, kind, layer, env, runtime}], connections}. exists:false means no systems.yml yet (repoboard systems detect proposes one); errors non-empty means the file failed to parse (systems/connections empty then). Use get_system for one system's full row plus resolved pointers.

tools.name: get_system
tools.title: Get one system
tools.description: RCB-97 (plan §3.3): one system's full row from .repoboard/systems.yml, every connection touching it, and its pointers resolved live (same engine as get_card resolveRefs: [{spec, path, start, end, text, truncated, error}]). Use list_systems to find ids. tests: the test files that import or name each pointer (static, live; null when a pointer is not a source file).

id.description: The system id, e.g. gateway (list_systems shows the ids).

tools.name: archive_cards
tools.title: Archive old done cards
tools.description: Move every card in a done column whose `updated` is older than olderThan (default 14d; also accepts 2h/90m or an ISO-8601 datetime) to .repoboard/archive/ — git mv when tracked, else a rename; the file is never rewritten. dryRun:true (default false) lists the ids and writes nothing. Archived cards no longer appear in list_cards; get_card on an archived id fails, naming the archive path.

dryRun.description: List ids only; write nothing. Default false.

actor.description: Who is acting, e.g. claude/agent. Default: $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".

tools.name: sync_issues
tools.title: Sync cards from a README-style K-list
tools.description: Reads `path` (repo-relative; ".." and absolute paths refused) and the section under the first heading whose text starts with `heading` — the same heading rule the board uses for `refs:`. An item is a list item whose FIRST LINE begins at column 0 with `- **K<n>` (open) or `- ~~**K<n>` (struck = closed); nothing else is an item. Creates a card (labels: [label], refs: [`path@K<n>`]) for every open item with no card yet; moves a struck or vanished item’s card to the done column. Idempotent by ref — a second call creates and moves nothing. NEVER writes `path`. dryRun:true (default false) reports the plan and writes nothing — the only mode to call against a repo you do not own.

status.description: Column new cards are created in. Default todo.

label.description: Label on created cards. Default issue.

dryRun.description: Report the plan only; write nothing.

actor.description: Who is acting, written `<tool>/<role>` (e.g. `claude/web-agent`) so the board can draw a stable avatar. Defaults to $REPOBOARD_ACTOR, then "mcp".
